query = """
	SELECT 
	    s.RunID,
	    p.ProductCode,
	    r.RunStartDateTime AS StartTime,
	    r.RunStopDateTime AS EndTime,
	    (r.CurrentInfeed - r.StartInfeed) AS Infeed,
	    r.GoodCount AS Outfeed,
	    r.WasteCount AS Waste,
	    r.Performance,
	    r.GoodCount,
	    r.TotalCount
	FROM run r
	INNER JOIN schedule s 
	    ON r.ID = s.RunID
	INNER JOIN workorder w
	    ON s.WorkorderID = w.ID
	INNER JOIN productcode p
	    ON w.ProductCodeID = p.ID
	WHERE r.RunStartDateTime >= ?
	  AND r.RunStopDateTime <= ?;
	"""
	
	# Ejecutar la query con los parámetros
	results = system.db.runPrepQuery(query, [self.params.startTime, self.params.endTime])
		
	return results
